[Section] The Joint Model
[source_id=23] The proposed joint model (“Joint” hereafter) combines the visual and textual embeddings (output of Inception and biLSTM) via a simple feed-forward layer and softmax over the document label set, as shown in Figure 2 . We optimize our model based on cross-entropy loss.
